header: What we are building, and what is already out
lead: Updated on the first working day of each month. Nothing is listed here before it has been designed, and nothing is quietly removed.
note: Dates are targets, not commitments. Anything that slips past its quarter is marked as such rather than moved without comment.

items.title: Shift marketplace between branches
items.text: Staff can now offer a shift to colleagues at any site their contract covers.

items.title: Offline clock-in on iOS
items.text: Punches are held on the device and signed, then sent when the connection returns.

items.title: Qualification expiry warnings
items.text: Thirty days' notice to the holder and their manager.

items.title: Budget forecasting by season
items.text: Beta with eight sites; general release expected in the third quarter.

items.title: Works council reporting pack
items.text: Standing reports on overtime, night work and short-notice changes.

items.text: Waiting on their API v3, which is announced for the autumn.
